items.claim: The LORD spoke to Moses with instructions about animal offerings
items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying

items.claim: Animals must be seven days old under their mother before being accepted as burnt offerings to the LORD
items.quote: When a bullock, or a sheep, or a goat, is brought forth, then it shall be seven days under the dam; and from the eighth day and thenceforth it shall be accepted for an offering made by fire unto the LORD
items.actor: a bullock, or a sheep, or a goat
items.action: shall be accepted for an offering
items.object: an offering made by fire unto the LORD
items.mechanism: seven days under the dam; from the eighth day
